why: HYPOTHESIS TEST off drain-engine, not a rival to it. Diagnosis: mana_short is 73% of the branch's stalls and mana at T5/T7 fell below v1.0.1 because the refactor cut Patchwork Banner, a rock, while deck-audit already had ramp UNDER target at 7 v 10-12. A one-for-one sweep moved stall by nothing on any of 11 candidates, because cheap cards cut mana_short and raise hand_empty and the two cancel. So the lever is compound: three mana sources for three off-axis spells. Deliberately does NOT cut Sanguine Bond (half a checker-verified infinite) or the X-based draw, which the model cannot price and would therefore recommend cutting for the wrong reason.
